name: John Deere Augusta Works (Commercial Products) - Grovetown GA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck operations are on a large fenced parcel; trucks enter off the John Deere Pkwy / Horizon South Pkwy access loop and pass into a perimeter-fenced operational yard with tree-buffer screening. Controlled truck entrance inferred from the continuous fence line and single internal truck route; barrier hardware not directly resolvable in imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth positively confirmed at a barrier-arm gate in available satellite/Street View imagery; the entrance is set deep behind tree buffers and Street View only covers the office/employee loop. A staffed entrance is plausible for a major Deere plant but unverified - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true tentatively (gate present, no confirmed guard shack); revise if a staffed booth is later confirmed.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Extensive paved aprons and access-road shoulders provide ample pre-gate truck staging.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Very large paved internal yard between the truck entrance and the dock faces.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal truck approach; easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Abundant unused paved width on the access loop and yard apron; clear room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors observed along the west and south faces of the main building plus the NW building, with trailers backed in; estimated 25-50 total, low-confidence count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large fenced trailer drop yard on the SW/W lots holds dense rows of 80-100+ parked trailers; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on physically separate building faces (west face and south face) plus the separate NW building.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park in Grovetown, GA; surrounded by woodland and other industrial parcels rather than dense metro fabric - classified Rural.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two distinct buildings (large main assembly building plus a smaller NW building) but a single integrated plant, not a multi-facility campus.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated on-site trailer-storage lots, distinct from active dock staging - one of the larger drop yards in this batch.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur observed entering the property.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified - flagged uncertain.
